tools.name: get-quickstart-guide
tools.description:
Provides step-by-step instructions for an AI assistant to set up a new JxBrowser project. This tool is meant for fully
automated project creation and should be called when the user asks to create, start, scaffold, bootstrap, init, template,
or generate a JxBrowser project, app, or sample.

CRITICAL

tools.name: ask-jxbrowser-question
tools.description:
The tool for getting help with JxBrowser.

Use this tool whenever you need information about JxBrowser, including but not limited to:
- API Documentation: Class methods, interfaces, callbacks, events
- Code Examples: How to implement specific features or use particular APIs
- Best Practices: Recomme

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get-quickstart-guide" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
